in_marathi.name: Asmitha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Asmitha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Asmitha is derived from the Sanskrit word 'asmi', meaning 'I am'. The suffix '-tha' signifies 'Goddess of'. Thus, Asmitha can be interpreted as the 'Goddess of Wisdom' or the 'Goddess of Knowledge'.
